versions.content: Initialization and Shutdown Description: Persistency shall support central initialization and shutdown. Additional Information: Application developers control the life cycle of all functional clusters using a central mechanism. This mechanism helps Persistency to prepare and clean up its environment in order to ensure a reliable behavior. E.g. the available storages need to be read from the manifest before any storage can be accessed. And before shutdown, all data of Persistency needs to be persisted.
